answer_2.quote: We used three widely used metrics for language generation to evaluate the tail generation quality, i.e., ROUGE , METEOR, and BERTscore.

answer_4.quote: Members of the research team rated a sample of 500 knowledge tuples, with each sample evaluated by three members. We use a 4-point Likert scoring metric, reflecting how reasonable each knowledge tuple is and ranging from Invalid (score 4) to Always/Often (score 1).
answer_4.guideline: 4-point Likert scale assessing the reasonableness of each generated knowledge tuple.
